_readme: The launcher's Events banner (home, above the news). Edit this file and push to main: running launchers read it from GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com, then cdn.jsdelivr.net where GitHub is blocked) at the start and every 15 minutes - no new launcher needed. Shown: what goes on now and what starts within 14 days, nearest first. start / end: ISO time WITH its zone (2026-11-08T18:00:00+03:00); end is optional. title / place: a string, or {"ru": "...", "en": "..."} (es / fr / de fall back to en). url: optional, an icon next to the event opens it. id: any unique text.
